name: Dear Butterflies
source:
Silvia was a university freshman. She got close to one of her seniors, Gaiya. 

But... something weird happened.

[From [url=https://altila.itch.io/dearbutterfliesvn]Itch.io[/url]]

但是……奇怪的事情发生了。
